description: You are coordinating a neighborhood street tree planting program. Open the workbook at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/StreetTreePlanting.xlsx. It contains reference sheets with tree species data, planting site constraints, and volunteer availability. Your task: (1) In the 'Master Plan' sheet, assign an appropriate tree species to each of the 12 planting sites, respecting constraints like overhead wires, sidewalk width, and resident preferences. (2) Assign a volunteer care captain to each site, ensuring no volunteer is overloaded. (3) Calculate first-year watering needs. (4) Document your rationale for species choices. Save the completed plan (Ctrl+S).
